purpose: Resolve the ecological interpretation of the Villavicencio empirical bridge after raw-source reconstruction, support-leakage repair, sampling-effort audit, effort-standardized response analysis, and latent detection modeling.

evidence_chain.result: 18 periods and 12 within-year transitions reconstructed from Figshare raw dated visits; 4,581 shared-dyad rows and 853 observed binary changes (422 gains, 431 losses)
evidence_chain.boundary: published RData byte identity remains unverified and binary zeros are detection-sensitive

evidence_chain.result: 5-min census identity reconstructed; subseason effort ranges 38-424 censuses; trait-subset Chao2 observed fraction 0.314-0.654; effort-change ranks observed gain over loss at AUC 0.815 in the dated core
evidence_chain.boundary: matched-effort rarefaction retains original gain/loss labels only around 0.58-0.60 on average

evidence_chain.result: annual gain association remains predictive after focal-plant census-count adjustment; opportunity increment beyond effort is positive in 3/3 strict-core and 4/4 near-core gain folds
evidence_chain.boundary: annual binary response remains detection-sensitive; loss increment is fold-unstable

evidence_chain.result: current focal-response-excluded opportunity has a small positive pooled increment beyond recent interaction history
evidence_chain.boundary: increment is positive in only 4/6 held-out subseason transitions and fails the frozen reproducibility rule

evidence_chain.result: simple repeated-detection model passes the frozen identifiability gate in 5/6 dated-core transitions; per-census detection probabilities are about 0.05-0.18
evidence_chain.boundary: posterior latent transition identity differs materially from observed binary gain/loss labels; the model remains a sensitivity analysis rather than ground truth

evidence_chain.surface: latent state versus current-detection opportunity decomposition
evidence_chain.result: detection-side opportunity support occurs in 4/6 transitions
evidence_chain.boundary: latent state-transition support occurs in only 1/6 versus a frozen 5/6 requirement; general state promotion fails

evidence_chain.result: beta-binomial detection is preferred over the simple binomial detection model in 6/6 primary transitions, with AIC improvements of at least 13.8
evidence_chain.boundary: at least one latent transition parameter hits the frozen state boundary in 6/6 transitions under the richer observation model, so detection-corrected gain/loss estimates are observation-model dependent

evidence_chain.result: For any two binary observations, P(0->1)-P(1->0)=P(Y_current=1)-P(Y_previous=1) without an independence assumption. For a persistent latent link this becomes q_current-q_previous. Using transition-specific fitted detection and dyad census counts, that detectability difference ranks observed gain over loss at AUC 0.852 across all six transitions and 0.837 across the five identified transitions.
evidence_chain.boundary: The fitted-q diagnostic is not independent ecological validation; q is estimated from the same repeated-census data. The general gain-minus-loss conservation identity is assumption-light, while the product and odds-ratio special cases require conditional-independence assumptions.

evidence_chain.result: Two strictly interior dynamic latent-state/detection parameterizations generate exactly the same observed transition table (P00=3/5, P01=1/5, P10=1/10, P11=1/10) while latent link prevalence changes in opposite directions: 1/4->1/2 (+1/4) versus 1/2->3/8 (-1/8).
evidence_chain.boundary: Generic occupancy/detection confounding is established literature; this is an explicit network gain/loss witness showing that the full aggregated binary transition table does not identify even the sign of latent prevalence change when detection is unknown. All psi, gamma, epsilon, q_previous and q_current values in both witnesses are strictly between 0 and 1, so the failure is not a boundary artifact.

claim_decisions.phenology_predicts_rewiring: REJECT_AS_STATED: the original published-overlap gain signal is support-leaky and quarantined
claim_decisions.current_opportunity_predicts_observed_li: SUPPORTED_DESCRIPTIVELY: especially for annual gain, but response remains detection-sensitive
claim_decisions.current_opportunity_predicts_effort_stan: MIXED: small pooled increment, positive in 4/6 subseason folds
claim_decisions.current_opportunity_drives_latent_link_r: NOT_SUPPORTED: state-side support 1/6 under the pre-frozen latent model-comparison rule
claim_decisions.current_opportunity_tracks_current_detec: SUPPORTED_AS_MODEL_COMPARISON_PATTERN: detection-side support 4/6 under the frozen rule
claim_decisions.detection_corrected_true_rewiring_identi: NO: richer beta-binomial detection is preferred in 6/6 transitions and latent transition estimates hit a frozen state boundary in 6/6, so inferred gain/loss remains observation-model dependent
claim_decisions.observed_gain_loss_direction_identified_: NO: exact detection identity shows that changing period-level detectability alone is sufficient to bias gain versus loss direction, and the Villavicencio diagnostic AUC is 0.852.
claim_decisions.observed_gain_loss_direction_explainable: SUPPORTED_MECHANISTICALLY: unequal period-level detection is sufficient to generate directional observed gain/loss under a persistent-link counterfactual; diagnostic AUC is 0.852 across six transitions
claim_decisions.binary_transition_table_identifies_laten: NO: a strictly interior exact witness gives the same observed gain/loss/stable table under both increasing and decreasing latent link prevalence.
claim_decisions.aggregate_gain_loss_imbalance_is_indepen: NO: on a fixed dyad universe, #gain-#loss equals the change in observed edge count exactly; it is not independent evidence for assembly versus disassembly mechanisms.

strongest_ecological_interpretation.statement: At short within-season scales, current ecological opportunity is strongly entangled with encounter/detection of active pollinators and does not show a reproducible general effect on latent link-state transitions. Apparent binary network rewiring is therefore substantially observation-state dependent in this system, and even detection-corrected latent transition estimates are sensitive to the observation model.
strongest_ecological_interpretation.annual_scale: Annual focal-response-excluded opportunity still carries predictive information beyond focal-plant census counts for link gain, so observation effort alone does not exhaust the annual association. The discrepancy between annual and within-season latent analyses argues for scale-dependent integration of opportunity, activity and detection rather than a universal rewiring mechanism.
strongest_ecological_interpretation.novelty_candidate: The useful empirical finding is not that phenology causes rewiring, but that a strong apparent rewiring predictor can decompose into current ecological activity/detectability once repeated-detection information is used.
strongest_ecological_interpretation.observation_model_boundary: A richer beta-binomial detection model is preferred in all 6/6 primary transitions and drives at least one latent transition parameter to the frozen boundary in all 6/6. The data therefore do not support a stable detection-corrected rewiring response under the tested observation models.
strongest_ecological_interpretation.detection_direction_identity: Binary turnover direction has an independence-free conservation law: observed gain minus observed loss equals the change in marginal observed-presence probability. On a persistent latent link this is q_current-q_previous. Thus detectability changes can create directional apparent turnover even without ecological state change; Villavicencio aligns strongly with this axis (AUC 0.852).
strongest_ecological_interpretation.detection_effort_identity: The gain/loss direction itself is strongly aligned with the exact observation-process asymmetry q_current-q_previous expected even when a latent interaction persists. This explains why effort/detection changes can mimic directional turnover without identifying any particular observed change as false.
strongest_ecological_interpretation.binary_turnover_nonidentifiability: Aggregated binary interaction turnover is not merely noisy: without detection information, the same full two-period transition table can correspond to opposite latent network changes even when all latent-transition and detection parameters are strictly interior. Repeated-detection or independent state information is therefore an identification requirement, not a cosmetic sensitivity.
strongest_ecological_interpretation.finite_turnover_balance: Aggregate excess gains or losses are algebraically identical to observed edge-count change on the same dyad universe. Mechanistic interpretation must therefore come from information beyond the gain-loss imbalance itself, especially detection-standardized state information.

forbidden_terms_without_new_evidence: phenology is a causal rewiring filter
current opportunity generally drives latent link gain/loss
detection-corrected rewiring as an identified ecological response
gain exceeds loss therefore assembly is biologically stronger than disassembly
next_scientific_gate: Stop adding flexible Villavicencio observation models to search for a positive rewiring mechanism. The binary transition table is formally non-identifying with respect to latent turnover direction when detection is unknown, and the Villavicencio repeated-census data further show observation-model sensitivity after detection modeling. A natural-network mechanism requires independent detection-standardized state information plus an independent decision layer, or experimental separation of ecological state from detection/encounter. The controlled routeability experiment remains the clean direct mechanism test.
claim_ceiling: Villavicencio supports reproducible response reconstruction, sampling/detection diagnostics, and ecological opportunity/activity associations. It does not identify binary or detection-corrected ecological rewiring as a stable natural response, and it does not validate routeability.
resolution_sentence: Sampling effort is no longer unresolved: its 5-min census semantics are reconstructed. What remains unresolved is the latent ecological link state. Binary turnover is materially detection-sensitive, its gain/loss direction is strongly aligned with the exact detection-effort observation map, effort-standardized incidence gives a fold-mixed opportunity increment, and latent transition inference is observation-model dependent.

trigger: binary observed-link turnover is materially detection-sensitive
latent state-side opportunity support fails the pre-frozen rule (1/6 vs required 5/6)
beta-binomial detection is preferred in 6/6 transitions and latent transition estimates hit a state boundary in 6/6
the full binary transition table is formally non-identifying for latent turnover direction under a strictly interior detection/state witness
observational_stop_rule.consequence: Do not add further flexible Villavicencio observation models whose purpose is to search for a positive natural-rewiring mechanism. New Villavicencio work must either test a pre-specified identification remedy with genuinely new independent information or remain a robustness/identification analysis.
allowed_next_evidence: independent repeated-detection data or externally validated observation model
experimental separation of ecological state from encounter/detection
controlled routeability experiment with an independent decision layer
